messages.author: d0742ae5a689d890
messages.subject: Installation problem - Windows 10
parts:
Dear all,
I am wildlife biologist using distance for density estimate of both terrestrial and arboreal African mammals and for the first time I am having troubles installing Distance 7.1 on a new laptop (Windows 10, 64bits).
Trying tot run the exe file, I receive an error saying "This app can't run on your PC. Check with software publisher"
Following another discussion in the group, I have unpacked the file with 7zip and run again the exe file, this time receiving the error: "Could not initialize installation. File size expected=69659863, size returned=21448878."

Did someone ever encountered this problem? Solutions found on the internet didn't help.

Many thanks for sharing tour ideas,

Mattia

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Installation problem - Windows 10
parts:
Mattia

We've done some checking at this end, and the size of the D7_1Release1.exe ought to be more like 39.4Mb, rather than the 21.4Mb you report after using 7zip.  We've also had an indication that download speed for the software is quite slow at the moment.  Perhaps your download may have been incomplete because of the slow speed. 

If you are willing, perhaps try to download again, unpack with 7Zip  and see if you can install from the resulting D7_1Release1.exe

messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Installation problem - Windows 10
parts:
Dear Eric,
thank you very much for your answers.
In fact, as you suggest in your last email, I think the problem must have been the slow download speed.
I tried a new download this morning: the download took much less and the executable file eventually worked just fine (no need of using 7zip either). 

Problem solved and thank you again for your quick answer and excellent job.

Best

Mattia
